qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve slicked-back hair, amber glasses, red/yellow coat with black fur, yellow trousers, two-tone shoes and studded leather belt. Existing buckle artwork stays a physical reference detail; no added gold-fist effect. Review belt topology, huge distance change, target-only contact and full-body end pose.
choreography:
IDENTITY: exact lean muscular adult brown-skinned man with slicked-back black hair, thin mustache and goatee, amber rectangular sunglasses, white-bead necklace, open red-and-yellow long coat with enormous black fur collar and cuffs, bright yellow flared trousers and black/white dress shoes. Preserve his long dark brown studded leather belt and its existing large oval buckle as a physical prop detail. Keep the original character and costume, no added fist-shaped power effect.
0–1.2s: full-body low-angle establishment. He draws the studded belt taut once between his hands, tilts the amber glasses down a fraction, then launches the buckle end forward with an elegant wrist snap. A huge charcoal padded training dummy hangs far ahead in empty cyan.
1.2–3.2s: camera accelerates along the flying buckle and pulls way back: the leather belt stretches into a tremendous curling loop across thirty feet of empty space while he remains a small complete figure at its origin. The buckle whips around the dummy and the belt catches it around its padded middle. Show ONE continuous belt from his hand to the target, no duplicated straps, hands or unexplained cuts.
3.2–4.8s: he pivots sharply and yanks. The enormous dummy swings toward him in a spectacular rising arc; he ducks beneath it and reverses the belt with a full-body backhand SNAP, sending the dummy hurtling away in the opposite direction. One colossal bounded ivory/red impact crescent and a hard contact hold at the reversal. Camera races with the target as it shrinks into the far cyan distance, belt releasing cleanly. This is an exaggerated prop stunt; no human opponent or injury.
4.8–6s: snap-zoom back to his composed face as the belt recoils in one clean spiral into his palm. Exact title BELT CHECK slams below his glasses with a heavy leather-and-metal impact. Black fur and coat tails settle without swallowing the background.
6–8s: whole-character hero hold, belt casually draped over his shoulder, entire silhouette framed on cyan. One tiny tuft of dummy stuffing lands on his yellow trouser leg. He brushes it off with two fingers, then nudges his glasses back up. SFX: leather tension creak, fast buckle whistle, enormous swinging air rush, dominant whip CRACK with deep padded hit, receding target whoosh, retracting belt flutter, title slam and tiny glasses click. No music, speech, scenery or floor.

qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve heavyset adult traveler, white cap/shirt, denim shorts, sandals, passport, cash and comic heart eyes. Review paper-plane/carry-on continuity, abstract cleansing ribbons, cyan through travel loops and long title. Existing passport cover label may remain; no invented readable country stamps.
choreography:
IDENTITY: exact heavyset adult dark-skinned man with neat black goatee, white baseball cap, loose white pocket T-shirt, torn blue denim shorts with drawstrings, brown/black strapped sandals and bracelets. Preserve his navy passport with boarding pass, fan of green banknotes and the exaggerated glowing pink heart-shaped eyes from the reference. Playful excited traveler, same build and outfit throughout.
0–1.2s: full-body establishment. He pockets the loose cash, pulls the pale boarding pass from his passport and gives it one triumphant flick. A small battered carry-on suitcase floats far away, tangled in finite dark-gray ribbon-like storm curls.
1.2–3.2s: the boarding pass folds itself into an enormous ivory paper passenger jet with thick navy ink edges. Camera rockets backward as he hops astride its broad body, passport held aloft. The jet launches through cyan space and sweeps under the trapped carry-on, catching it safely on one wing. Convey great distance with foreground paper folds, separated orange speed strokes and scale changes, not an airport, clouds, map or landscape.
3.2–4.8s: the giant paper jet performs one spectacular climbing loop through TWO separate oval travel-stamp rings, one rust-red and one deep violet, both with empty cyan centers and abstract border marks only. At the first ring the dark ribbons peel off the suitcase; at the second the suitcase brightens and pops open to reveal neatly packed clothes. A huge bounded cream/coral impact bloom marks the second pass, like a sonic boom of paper and clean air. Powerful payoff, no lettering in the stamp rings, no rectangular portal background or full-frame flash.
4.8–6s: camera snap-tracks him back toward the foreground. He steps off the jet into a balanced hero stance; the entire plane folds down neatly into the original boarding pass and slides into his passport. Exact title GEOGRAPHIC ARBITRAGE slams in two large readable lines beneath his face.
6–8s: full-body hold beside the restored carry-on. He proudly opens his passport; one endless accordion strip of blank boarding passes spills out. He looks briefly surprised, then fans it like money with a delighted grin and bright heart eyes. SFX: ticket flick, huge paper unfurl, rising jet-like wind, two accelerating ring whooshes, dominant sonic paper BOOM, precise refolding clicks, title slam and long paper flutter. No speech, music or human crowd sounds.

choreography:
IDENTITY: exact enormous muscular adult dark-skinned bald man with short black goatee and stern face, immaculate navy pinstripe suit, white shirt and pocket square, dark violet tie with gold tie bar, gold wristwatch and cufflinks, glossy black dress shoes. Preserve his black hard briefcase with gold corners and round globe design. Preserve his electrical power theme using bright ivory cores and deep INDIGO/VIOLET outlined arcs for the large new effects; no cyan or turquoise glow. No giant symbolic fists or extra emblems.
0–1.2s: full-body low-angle shot. He checks the gold watch, adjusts one cuff, then tosses the briefcase straight upward. Three small separate electric pulses snap into the watch in quick succession; his eyes focus. The case rises slowly enough to be caught at the end.
1.2–3.2s: camera pulls dramatically back, revealing THREE gigantic detached steel training weights arranged at widely separated depths. He explodes forward from his full-body stance, an isolated jagged ivory/indigo speed trail showing his path. Camera chases at shoulder height: one thunderous shoulder check sends the nearest massive weight spinning away. Brief hard contact hold, sparks terminate on cyan; no floor, office or city.
3.2–4.8s: without stopping he rebounds toward the second weight and strikes it with a rising ELBOW, then pivots midair into a colossal heel strike against the third. Three distinct coherent contacts total: shoulder, elbow, heel. Each hit gets larger and heavier; the final weight erupts in a bounded ivory/violet impact star and tumbles away like a toy. Pull out on the last hit to show his whole extended body and all three displaced weights at different depths. Loud final metal BOOM, no full-screen strobe or background replacement.
4.8–6s: he reverses direction through one huge arc and races back to his original position, calmly catching the descending briefcase in the same hand that tossed it. Camera snap-zooms up to his unruffled face as exact title OVERTIME slams below his tie with an enormous clock-like metallic CLANG.
6–8s: whole-character hero hold with briefcase by his side. He checks the watch again; its second hand has advanced exactly one tick. He smooths his tie, unimpressed. One stubborn tiny lightning arc jumps from his cuff; he pinches it out like lint. Stable suit, face and case. SFX: watch ticks, three charging clicks, accelerating electrical rush, three rising steel impacts ending in a dominant BOOM, returning air snap, briefcase handle catch, title CLANG and tiny final electrical fizz. No music, speech or narration.
